results.title: India's 'Cockroach' protest movement leaders freed from detention, vow to continue demonstrations
results.content: Leaders of the Cockroach Janata Party, an Indian youth movement, were released Sunday after being detained ahead of protests against a voter list revision.

results.title: What to Know About the Protests in India
results.content: Protesters opposed to sweeping revisions to India's voter rolls are trying to rally in New Delhi. The police have come out in force.

results.title: India's 'cockroach' leaders defy crackdown to continue protests
results.content: Leaders of a popular Indian youth movement vowed to continue protests Sunday after their release from police custody, following a crackdown

results.title: Protesters Seeking India Election Chief's Ouster Detained, as 'Cockroach' Leaders Released
results.content: Commuters cross a checkpoint as police officers stand guard on the second day of a protest planned by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) seeking the resignation of India's Chief Election Commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar, in New Delhi, India, October 11, 2026. REUTERS/Priyanshu Singh
